_comment: Baseline of accepted hardcoded user-facing English in the desktop UI (spec NFR-007, PR6). Produced by triaging every candidate from `node scripts/check-hardcoded-strings.mjs --report`: entries are grouped per file+category to keep one surface reason from repeating 200 times, but every literal is recorded individually and matched exactly by `<file>|<kind>|<literal>`; there is no wildcard, prefix or directory allowlist, and only `deferred-pr4-surface` may lean on the group note — every other category requires a per-literal reason. Resolve a candidate by translating it (en.json + zh-Hans.json + t()) or by adding an entry naming one of the categories defined in check-hardcoded-strings.mjs. `true-violation` entries always fail the gate. Entries that no longer match a candidate are reported as stale/advisory: prune them when the owning surface is closed out.
